verdict.rationale: Mastercard Open Finance exposes a well-documented public REST API (accounts, transactions, balances, ACH, verification, etc.) with token-based auth, sandbox/test-drive access, OpenAPI spec/client generation, webhooks, and an llms.txt plus an official MCP/agent toolkit enabling AI tools to query and generate code against the API. This gives strong evidence of a documented, machine-consumable API surface suitable for AI-native driving. Missing for 10: no independent/third-party corroboration of AI agents successfully driving the API end-to-end, and no explicit examples of autonomous agent workflows beyond code-generation/doc-lookup use cases.
